keyFindings.description: The documented tagging rule (R1-R6, 'When unsure, tag it') does not give the selection the PR made: the table drops every test that cannot run at the iphone project's own viewport (it skips every project but chromium, sets a desktop viewport itself, or is webkit-iphone-only), but R1/R5/R6 say to tag agents.e2e.ts:759/847/953/1001, issue.e2e.ts:697, keyboard-palette.e2e.ts:1030, mention-composer.e2e.ts:443, delivery-live.e2e.ts:454, and margin-thread-reply.e2e.ts:216. The last one lost its iphone skip (whose reason was 'below xl the margin is a sheet, with no rail') and still passes testInfo.project.name to openThread -> setSheet at a 1440 px viewport, so a future author following R1 tags it and it fails under iphone. The closing sentence 'a test that skips iphone has no reason to: drop the skip' also contradicts the 50 surviving `!== "chromium"` skips. Acceptance 2 asks for a followable selection: state the precondition before R1-R6 and make the skip sentence give one answer; pass "chromium" at margin-thread-reply.e2e.ts:226.

The comment says the regex is anchored because the grep text holds 'iphone' and 'phone.e2e.ts'; neither contains '@', so an unanchored /@phone/ would not match them. The anchors stop '@phone' matching inside a longer token ('@phones', 'x@phone'), which is what the negative controls exercised.
Untagged tests keep `project.name === "iphone" ? "390" : "1280"`; iphone no longer runs them, so the 390 arm is dead, the same kind of dead iphone code the PR removed elsewhere.

verified: Playwright 1.63.0 project grep runs on _grepTitleWithTags (project, file, describe titles, test title joined by spaces), so the anchored /(^|\s)@phone(\s|$)/ matches test- and describe-level tags (thermonuclear-deep-review).

All 75 removed test.skip calls have the single condition testInfo.project.name === "iphone" (reviewer's diff extraction).

Direct-body AST scan of untagged tests plus the deep reviewer's transitive scan (helpers, hooks): no test that iphone ran at base and that takes a phone-only path is untagged; sampled drop rows (agents-search.e2e.ts:61, inbox.e2e.ts:355, inbox.e2e.ts:742, ask-blocks.e2e.ts:110) match their table reasons.
Both E2E lines present in the PR body; 0 review threads; no contract change at a process or package boundary, so no census is needed.
